## Connector: Apollo (lookup)

Looks each person up with Apollo's People Enrichment and returns their current job, work history and (when Apollo has it) their new work email, so the email finder can be skipped.

Apollo only charges a credit when it finds someone. **Phone numbers are never requested** (they cost extra credits).

**Setup:**
1. On **Apollo Request**, create a Header Auth credential: name `x-api-key`, value your Apollo API key (Settings > Integrations > API).
2. Copy this workflow's ID into the core Config as `lookup_1_connector_id` (slot name `apollo`), with a monthly budget.

**Action:** lookup_person.

**Publish** this workflow once it is set up (top right). n8n only lets scheduled and webhook-started runs call published workflows.

Contract: docs/connectors.md in the repo.
